name: Riyadh Cement Company
summary: Riyadh Cement Company produces and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the Kingdom of Bahrain, the State of Iraq, State of Yemen, the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, and the Sultanate of Oman. It offers grey and white cement; and finishing, sulfate-resistant Portland, ordinary Portland cement, as well as white Portland cement type I and II. The company was formerly known as Saudi White Cement Company and changed its name to Riyadh Cement Company in February 2021. Riyadh Cement Company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
